border-bottom: Все свойства нижней границы одной декларацией
border-left: Все свойства левой границы одной декларацией
border-right: Все свойства правой границы одной декларацией
border-top: Все свойства верхней границы одной декларацией
element1~element2: Общий сосед (`~`) — после того же родителя
:first-of-type: Первый элемент своего типа у родителя
:last-of-type: Последний элемент своего типа у родителя
color-profile: Разрешает the specification of a source color profile other than the default
rendering-intent: Разрешает the specification of a color profile rendering intent other than the default
target-name: Задаёт where to open links (target destination)
target-new: Задаёт whether new destination links should open in a new window or in a new tab of an existing window
target-position: Задаёт where new destination links should be placed
marquee-direction: Устанавливает the direction of the moving content
marquee-play-count: Устанавливает how many times the content move
marquee-speed: Устанавливает how fast the content scrolls
marquee-style: Устанавливает the style of the moving content
box-align: Задаёт how to align the child elements of a box
box-direction: Задаёт in which direction the children of a box are displayed
box-flex: Задаёт whether the children of a box is flexible or inflexible in size
box-flex-group: Assigns flexible elements to flex groups
box-lines: Задаёт whether columns will go onto a new line whenever it runs out of space in the parent box
box-ordinal-group: Задаёт display order of the child elements of a box
box-orient: Задаёт whether the children of a box should be laid out horizontally	or vertically
box-pack: Задаёт horizontal position in horizontal boxes and the vertical position in vertical boxes
alignment-adjust: Позволяет more precise alignment of elements
alignment-baseline: Задаёт how an inline-level element is aligned with respect to its parent
baseline-shift: Позволяет repositioning of the dominant-baseline relative to the dominant-baseline
drop-initial-after-adjust: Устанавливает the alignment point of the drop initial for the primary connection point
drop-initial-after-align: Устанавливает which alignment line within the initial line box is used at the primary connection point with the initial letter box
drop-initial-before-adjust: Устанавливает the alignment point of the drop initial for the secondary connection point
drop-initial-before-align: Устанавливает which alignment line within the initial line box is used at the secondary connection point with the initial letter box
drop-initial-size: Управляет the partial sinking of the initial letter
inline-box-align: Устанавливает which line of a multi-line inline block align with the previous and next inline elements within a line
line-stacking: A shorthand property for setting the line-stacking-strategy, line-stacking-ruby, and line-stacking-shift properties
line-stacking-ruby: Устанавливает the line stacking method for block elements containing ruby annotation elements
line-stacking-shift: Устанавливает the line stacking method for block elements containing elements with base-shift
line-stacking-strategy: Устанавливает the line stacking strategy for stacked line boxes within a containing block element
text-height: Устанавливает the block-progression dimension of the text content area of an inline box
bookmark-target: Задаёт target of the bookmark link
float-offset: Сдвигает floated elements in the opposite direction of the where they have been floated with float
hyphenate-after: Задаёт minimum number of characters in a hyphenated word after the hyphenation character
hyphenate-before: Задаёт minimum number of characters in a hyphenated word before the hyphenation character
hyphenate-character: Задаёт a string that is shown when a hyphenate-break occurs
hyphenate-lines: Указывает the maximum number of successive hyphenated lines in an element
hyphenate-resource: Задаёт a comma-separated list of external resources that can help the browser determine hyphenation points
marks: Добавляет crop and/or cross marks to the document
crop: Позволяет a replaced element to be just a rectangular area of an object, instead of the whole object
move-to: Переносит an element to be removed from the flow and reinserted at a later point in the document
page-policy: Определяет which page-based occurance of a given element is applied to a counter or string value
fit: Подсказка: a hint for how to scale a replaced element if neither its width nor its height property is auto
fit-position: Определяет the alignment of the object inside the box
page: Задаёт a particular type of page where an element SHOULD be displayed
size: Задаёт size and orientation of the containing box for page content
orphans: Минимум строк внизу страницы при разрыве
widows: Минимум строк вверху страницы при разрыве
mark-after: Позволяет named markers to be attached to the audio stream
mark-before: Позволяет named markers to be attached to the audio stream
phonemes: Задаёт a phonetic pronunciation for the text contained by the corresponding element
rest-after: Задаёт a rest or prosodic boundary to be observed after speaking an element's content
rest-before: Задаёт a rest or prosodic boundary to be observed before speaking an element's content
voice-balance: Задаёт balance between left and right channels
voice-duration: Задаёт how long it should take to render the selected element's content
voice-pitch: Задаёт average pitch (a frequency) of the speaking voice
voice-stress: Указывает the strength of emphasis to be applied
voice-volume: Относится к to the amplitude of the waveform output by the speech synthesises
icon: Provides the author the ability to style an element with an iconic equivalent
nav-down: Задаёт where to navigate when using the arrow-down navigation key
nav-index: Задаёт tabbing order for an element
nav-left: Задаёт where to navigate when using the arrow-left navigation key
nav-right: Задаёт where to navigate when using the arrow-right navigation key
nav-up: Задаёт where to navigate when using the arrow-up navigation key
